page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor built on x86_64 architecture. Managed via the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core, 33 MB of L3 cache, and dedicated CPU allocation. Hardware instruction support includes AVX-512, AES, FMA, BMI2, and ADX. The instance includes 64.0 GB of RAM, offering 4.0 GB of memory per core. Local NVMe SSD storage is not bundled, and network connectivity provides a 7 Gbps baseline bandwidth without complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

In performance benchmarks, the ecs.g5ne.4xlarge yields balanced multi-core execution alongside lower single-core metrics. Single-threaded benchmarks, including single-core stress-ng, single-core Geekbench, and single-threaded gzip compression, fall in the bottom percentile tiers. Multi-threaded evaluations, such as multi-core stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU tests, achieve average middle-tier results. Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 69.78 GB/sec and write bandwidth reaches 51.98 GB/sec, placing memory throughput in the average category. Workload evaluations demonstrate steady multi-threaded execution with static web serving throughput of 7.75 GB/sec and Redis SET performance of 11.72 million operations per second.

The hardware profile highlights a clear tradeoff between single-threaded processor speeds and scalable multi-threaded capability. The absence of local block storage necessitates reliance on external network-attached volumes for data persistence. With its balanced 1:4 CPU-to-RAM ratio and solid parallel compute performance, the server provides cost-effective resource density for general web serving, application backends, software compilation pipelines, and containerized microservices.
